resources.string: Open Community Golf on your phone
Search for a course and start a round.
Android Auto available — open Community Golf in your cart for dash yardage
Community Golf is free and built on open data. If it helps your game, an optional tip keeps it growing.
Community Golf uses your location while you play to show distance to the green and tee. Location is used only on this device for yardage and is not required to search for courses.
We use on-device location for yardage during a round. Course search uses OpenGolfAPI. Hole maps use OpenStreetMap. Optional tips use Google Play Billing. Cached course data stays on your phone.
Anonymous analytics and crash reports help improve the app. You can turn this off anytime.
